# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 59 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 47 | Coptic

---

## Saying 59

Jesus said: "Look upon the Living One while you are alive, lest you die and seek to see him and be unable."

---

**Council Notes:**

- "The Living One" preserved as a title throughout (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA agree).
- "Lest" (LOGOS) is preferred over EMET's "so that you will not" for concision; PNEUMA's "otherwise" is acceptable but slightly paraphrastic.
- The urgency of present vision vs. post-mortem inability is the theological core; all agents preserve it.
- Cross-reference: Saying 1 (whoever finds the interpretation of these sayings will not taste death); John 8:51.
